title: Refactoring UI - Tuple
text: Hey guys, welcome back to another edition of Refactoring UI. Today we're going to be taking a look at a submission from my friend Ben Ornstein. Ben, along with his friends Joel Sutherland and Spencer Dixon are starting a new project called Tupel, which is a screen sharing tool made specifically for pair programming. And to kick things off, they created this landing page to generate some interest. This is a project that I'm really excited about using myself, so I was really happy to help them out with this.
